title: Skillet Apple Pandowdy
summary: Tender skillet apples in a light apple-juice syrup under shingled squares of flaky sour-cream pastry, baked golden and pressed into the juices.
equipment: baking tray lined with baking paper
25 cm ovenproof frying pan with lid

ingredients.note: plain cultured sour cream; check the label

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
unsalted butter, cut into 5 mm pieces and frozen 15 min
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Make the pastry
steps.text: Mix the water and sour cream. Pulse or rub the flour, sugar and salt with the frozen butter until the pieces are like large peas, then add the sour-cream water and mix just until large clumps form. Press into a disc, wrap and chill 1 h; frozen butter gives bold flaky layers.

steps.title: Cut the squares
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Roll the dough to a 25 cm round on a floured surface, cut into roughly 6 cm squares (edge pieces will be smaller), lay on the lined tray and chill 30 min. Cold squares keep their shape in the heat.

steps.title: Cook the apples
steps.text: Peel, core and cut the apples into 1 cm wedges and toss with the brown sugar, cinnamon and salt. Melt the butter in the pan over medium heat, add the apples, cover and cook 10 min, stirring now and then, until they soften and release juice. Whisk the apple juice, cornflour and lemon juice, stir in and simmer uncovered 2-3 min until thickened, then take off the heat.

steps.title: Shingle the top
steps.text: Lay the pastry squares over the apples, overlapping slightly like loose shingles. Brush with egg and sprinkle with the sugar mixed with the cinnamon for a crackly, spiced finish.

steps.title: Bake and press
steps.text: Bake 20-25 min until the pastry is golden and puffed and the juices bubble between the pieces. With a spoon, press a few squares into the juices, then bake 5 min more; the pressed pieces soak up syrup while the rest stay crisp.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.text: Cool 15 min, then spoon into 6 bowls with plain yoghurt or whipped cream. Leftovers keep, covered and chilled, up to 2 days; warm them at 180 °C (160 °C fan) for 15 min.

tips: Golden Delicious apples hold their shape and stay sweet.
Common mistake: rolling warm dough. Keep the squares chilled until the moment they go on the apples.
Use unsweetened apple juice so the syrup is not too sweet.
safety: Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge up to 2 days and reheat at 180 °C (160 °C fan) about 15 min until hot. The pastry softens on standing.
